final.result:
I've completed the search phase of this blueprint. Here is my report.

## Report: Case-Source Retrieval Attempt

**Work objective (unchanged):** Identify the guidance documents, international standards, and consensus standards relevant to a given regulatory situation, and produce a curated reference list documenting each identified source and its relevance.

### Searches Performed (2 of 2 used)

| # | Query focus | Targeted input nodes |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | Medical device technical file project repository — ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, applicable standards | i1 (regulatory scope), i2 (product/process description), i3 (standards listings) |
| 2 | Open-source regulatory submission dossier with list of applicable standards and FDA guidance | i1, i3 |

### WebFetch Attempt (1 of 1 used)

- **URL fetched:** `https://ismg-cdn.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com` (CDRH Draft Guidance Cover Sheet — the only non-truncated URL pointing to what appeared to be an original FDA-sourced document rather than a blog/summary)
- **Result:** **HTTP 403 Forbidden** — page not accessible to WebFetch.

### Exact Source URLs Returned by WebSearch

| URL | Nature of page |
|---|---|
| `https://matrixone.health/Blog` | Blog — AAMI standards & cybersecurity in medical devices |
| `https://docxpert.io/use-cases/medtech` | Vendor QMS software marketing page |
| `https://blog.cm-dm.com/post/2016/02/05` | Blog post on FDA interoperable devices guidance |
| `https://operonstrategist.com` | Consulting firm — SaMD documentation overview |
| `https://www.medtechdive.com/news` | News article on De Novo guidance |
| `https://cybellum.com/Blog` | Blog — medical device compliance resources |
| `https://sunmantechnology.com` | Vendor — FDA approval process overview |
| `https://24x7mag.com/FDAUpdates/DraftGuidances` | News blurb on FDA draft guidance |
| `https://www.cliffsnotes.com/HealthScience` | Study notes — compiled FDA guidance list |
| `https://ismg-cdn.nyc3.cdn.digitaloceanspaces.com` | CDN-hosted file — **403 Forbidden** |
| `https://www.researchgate.net/publication` (truncated) | Truncated — not pursued |
| `https://www.scribd.com/document` (truncated) | Truncated — not pursued |
| `https://www.slideshare.net/Business` (truncated) | Truncated — not pursued |

### Assessment Against Critical Input Nodes

| Node | Description | Coverage status |
|---|---|---|
| **i1** | Regulatory context, scope, jurisdiction | **Not covered by an original case file.** Search results establish that medical-device regulatory frameworks (FDA/EU MDR) are the implied domain, but no original technical file defines the specific regulatory situation. |
| **i2** | Organization's product/process/activity description | **Not covered.** No workspace-style technical documentation (specifications, design docs, test artifacts) was found in any project repository. |
| **i3** | Reference sources listing standards with titles, issuing bodies, scope | **Partially surfaced but not retrieved as primary sources.** Several results *mention* standards (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, AAMI, FDA guidance) but none provide a native standards catalog or register document; they are blog/news summaries. |

### Provisional Coverage & Remaining Gaps

- **What is available:** The searches confirm the regulatory domain (medical devices, FDA/CDRH and EU MDR) and surface a recurring cluster of standards names (ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, IEC 62366-1, ISO 15223-1, ISO 14155) and FDA guidance topics (Design Controls FDA-2020-D-0957, De Novo, SaMD). These names could seed a candidate list.
- **What is missing (gaps):**
  1. No single coherent professional case with original technical files was found. All accessible results are secondary (blogs, vendor pages, news, study notes).
  2. The one URL pointing to a primary-source artifact returned HTTP 403 — inaccessible.
  3. Several URLs were truncated and were not repaired, per instructions.
  4. No project repository (e.g., GitHub/GitLab with regulatory documentation) appeared in results.
  5. The standard texts themselves are copyrighted (ISO/IEC/AAMI) and were not retrieved.

### Verification Disclaimer

The snippets and standard names observed in search summaries are **unverified observations from secondary sources**, not confirmed evidence of applicability. No primary standard text, regulatory guidance document, or organization technical file was successfully retrieved and verified. Deliverable **d1** (curated standards and guidance reference list) therefore cannot be reliably populated from the retrieved material alone.

### Conclusion

**Tool failure for case-file retrieval:** The single accessible primary-source candidate returned HTTP 403, and all other returned URLs are secondary/marketing/news pages that do not meet the blueprint's requirement for original technical files or native standards documents covering critical input nodes i1, i2, and i3. No sources were invented and the work objective was not modified.
